subject: Demo orbit: finalizing calendar handoff and introducing Security & Procurement

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Security Ops <secops@finbank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finbank.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo orbit: finalizing calendar handoff and introducing Security & Procurement

Hi Alice —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: we covered Redwood's hosted and dedicated options, latency/cost tradeoffs for your inference workloads, and your SSO + data segregation constraints.
- Primary ask from FinBank: a 60–75 minute technical demo (deep dive) with platform and security leads present; procurement wants an initial checklist of commercial/onboarding steps.

Proposed demo windows (all PT):
1) Tue Mar 9, 10:00–11:15
2) Wed Mar 10, 14:00–15:15
3) Thu Mar 11, 09:00–10:15

Can you confirm which of these works best for your team? If none, please share two alternate 60–75 minute slots.

Looping in Marissa Cole (solutions engineer) who will run the technical walkthrough, and Sean Gallagher (customer success) for onboarding / procurement cadence. We’ve attached a short MVP-demo-outline and a setup-checklist so your infra and security folks can skim prior to the session.

Attachments: MVP-demo-outline.pdf, setup-checklist.xlsx

Next steps on our side once we lock a time:
- Marissa will prepare a targeted demo focusing on SSO flow and network egress controls.
- Sean will send a one-page procurement timeline and list of required contract artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to locking time.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed Mar 10, 14:00–15:15 PT works best for our platform + security leads. I’m looping in Bob Turner from Procurement (bob.turner@finbank.com) for any commercial checklist items.

Security Ops: could you confirm whether you want a pre-demo readout of our SSO expectations (SAML metadata, IdP flow) or if the demo can cover it live? If a short readout is preferred, we can share the SSO spec by end of day tomorrow.
